limitations: Fresh-process approximate Linux VmRSS sampled every 5ms; peaks are lower bounds. smaps_rollup provides exact RSS/PSS at endpoints.
Cold peak growth excludes process-ready baseline; retained results remain charged until release.
Memory sampling is isolated from timings/profiles/tests; memory-run elapsed values are not comparison timing claims.
Same million-row Parquet fixture, 1/4 workers, two reversed variant/worker rounds; only peGosus measured here, exact before/after fingerprint validation required separately.
